items.title: Real Madrid confident of signing Rodri  - Saturday's gossip
items.summary: Real Madrid are confident they will sign Rodri from Man City, Arsenal eye player-plus-cash deal for Atletico striker Julian Alvarez, while Roma are keen on Fulham winger Oscar Bobb, plus more.

items.title: Chelsea in talks for Villa set-piece guru MacPhee
items.summary: Chelsea are looking to sign highly regarded set-piece coach Austin MacPhee from Aston Villa but they face competition from Premier League and Saudi Pro League clubs.

items.title: Newcastle seal £34m move for Monaco's Bamba
items.summary: Newcastle United have signed Monaco midfielder Aladji Bamba for a fee which could rise to £34m.

items.title: Chelsea agree deal to sign Palace defender Lacroix
items.summary: Chelsea agree deal to sign France defender Maxence Lacroix from Crystal Palace after two impressive seasons.

items.title: Rodri to have back surgery but Maresca brushes off transfer speculation
items.summary: World Cup winner Rodri is to have back surgery, says new Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca.

items.title: Palace want teenage Brest defender Le Guen
items.summary: Crystal Palace are interested in signing 19-year-old Brest centre-back Raphael le Guen.

items.title: Hearts sign Mendy for potential Forest Green record fee
items.summary: Forest Green Rovers sell midfielder Laurent Mendy to Heart of Midlothian for what the National League outfit say could be a club record fee of nearly £1m "if all targets are met".

items.title: Former Brighton keeper Baggaley joins Birmingham
items.summary: Newly-promoted Birmingham City sign goalkeeper Sophie Baggaley as a free agent after she leaves Brighton.

items.title: Anderson's journey to England star and  Man City record signing
items.summary: Elliot Anderson was a key part of England's World Cup side and is now Manchester City's record signing.

items.title: Codina on why she joined West Ham project
items.summary: Laia Codina won trophies and found a "new family" during her three-year spell at Arsenal - but she was ready for a change with West Ham.

items.title: Garnacho, Rogers and two clubs trying to balance the books
items.summary: How can Chelsea afford Morgan Rogers? And why are Aston Villa pursuing a loan for Alejandro Garnacho rather than buying him?

items.title: Man Utd bring in Leicester goalkeeper Leitzig
items.summary: Manchester United sign goalkeeper Janina Leitzig from Leicester City for an undisclosed fee.

items.title: Newcastle closing in on Liverpool forward Kiernan
items.summary: Newcastle United are in advanced talks to sign Republic of Ireland forward Leanne Kiernan from Liverpool.

items.title: Inter Milan interested in signing Tottenham captain Romero
items.summary: Inter Milan are interested in signing Tottenham captain Cristian Romero, according to Sky in Italy.

digest_md:
- **Newcastle** seal £34m move for Monaco's **Bamba** — new PL signing to watch.
- **Chelsea** agree deal for Palace defender **Lacroix** — Chelsea gain a defender; **Palace** lose a starter, denting their backline value.
- **Chelsea** in talks for Villa set-piece coach **MacPhee** — could boost Chelsea's dead-ball threat.
- **Palace** chasing teenage Brest defender **Le Guen** — one for the watchlist, not immediate returns.
- **Man City's Rodri** to have back surgery — expect limited early minutes; avoid at premium price.
- **Spurs** captain **Romero** linked with Inter Milan — monitor before investing in his defence.
